llm.localCliIsolationHint: Optional for Claude Code and Codex CLI. When enabled, LLM Wiki asks the CLI to ignore user-level rules/config/MCP/tools where supported. This is configuration isolation, not a process sandbox: the CLI still uses your local login credentials and network access. Leave off if you intentionally rely on your local CLI setup.
llm.localCliIsolationOn: Isolation on: user CLI rules, MCP/tools, and persisted sessions are disabled where the CLI supports it. Local credentials and network access are still controlled by the CLI itself.

llm.requestTimeoutHint: Increase this for slow local CPU models. The default is 30 minutes.
llm.streamingOutputHint: When disabled, HTTP providers wait for the complete response before displaying it. CLI providers still use their native protocol but buffer visible output until completion.
llm.streamingOutputOn: Streaming on: response text appears as it is generated.
llm.streamingOutputOff: Streaming off: response text appears after generation completes.

embedding.title: Embeddings & Busca Vetorial
embedding.description: Configure a busca semântica por vetores com LanceDB.
embedding.enableHint: When off, search uses token matching only.
embedding.endpointHint: OpenAI-compatible example: http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/embeddings. Gemini example: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta with model gemini-embedding-001. Volcengine example: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3 with model doubao-embedding-vision.
embedding.modelHint: Common examples are suggested, but custom OpenAI-compatible model IDs are accepted.
embedding.outputDimensionalityHint: Optional. Sent only for Gemini native embedContent endpoints as `output_dimensionality`; OpenAI-compatible endpoints ignore this field. Leave empty for the model default. Rebuild embeddings after changing model or dimension.
embedding.extraHeadersHint: Optional. One per line, formatted `Header-Name: value`. Used for gateways that route by request header — e.g. mify needs `X-Model-Provider-Id: siliconflow`. Authorization, Content-Type, Host, Content-Length, and x-goog-api-key are managed by the client and will be ignored.
embedding.maxChunkCharsHint: Target size of each chunk. Lower this (e.g. 500) when your endpoint's context is small (llama.cpp n_ctx=512, mxbai-embed-large, etc.).
embedding.overlapChunkCharsHint: Characters of overlap between adjacent chunks so ideas aren't severed at boundaries.
embedding.concurrencyHint: Maximum embedding requests in flight (1–32). Increase gradually according to your endpoint's capacity.
embedding.batchSizeHint: OpenAI-compatible endpoints only (1–64). Unsupported providers automatically use single-input requests.
embedding.providerTestsHint: Connection test sends one short embedding request. Functional test verifies stable finite vectors and reports the returned dimension.
embedding.legacyPromptBody: Your project has {{count}} entries in the old per-page vector store. The new per-chunk index gives better retrieval but needs a one-time re-embed. Run "Re-index all pages" to upgrade.

multimodal.title: Processamento Multimodal
multimodal.description: Configurações para extração de imagens em PDFs e legendas com modelos de visão.
multimodal.enableHint: Off: image references are stripped from ingested content — no images appear in wiki pages, search won't return them. (Files still extract to wiki/media/ for the raw-source preview.) On: each new image gets a factual caption from the vision LLM (cached by hash) and lands in the wiki page's alt text.
multimodal.useMainHint: Reuse the model picked under Settings → LLM provider. Only enable this if that model accepts image input — text-only models will return a 400.
multimodal.customEndpointHint: OpenAI-compatible /v1 base. LM Studio, llama.cpp server, vLLM, LocalAI all work.
multimodal.azureEndpointHint: Use your Azure OpenAI resource endpoint. The model field is the deployment name.
multimodal.azureApiVersionHint: Sent as the Azure OpenAI api-version query parameter.
multimodal.azureModelFamilyHint: Choose GPT-5 / o-series if this deployment rejects max_tokens or non-default temperature.
multimodal.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank for local / no-auth endpoints
multimodal.modelHint: Must be a vision-capable model. Text-only models will fail with a 400 / image-not-supported error at first ingest.
multimodal.concurrencyHint: How many caption requests run in parallel. 1 = strictly sequential. 4 is a good default for most setups; raise to 8+ only on a beefy GPU or hosted endpoint.
multimodal.costPoint1: Each new image triggers one vision-LLM call (~500-2000 tokens depending on model + thinking mode).
multimodal.costPoint2: Captions are cached by SHA-256 of image bytes. Duplicate logos / shared chart templates across documents only ever incur ONE call.
multimodal.costPoint3: Rust-side filter drops images smaller than 100×100 px and caps at 500 images per source — pathological PDFs can't blow up the bill.
multimodal.costPoint4: Prefer a local vision model (Qwen2.5-VL via LM Studio / Ollama) for bulk ingestion; reserve hosted vision APIs for one-off high-stakes documents.

apiServer.title: Servidor de API Local & MCP
apiServer.description: API REST local e servidor MCP para integração com Claude Code, Codex e outros agentes.
apiServer.enableHint: Disable to make every non-/health endpoint return 503 even if a token is configured. Useful as a kill-switch without unsetting the token.
apiServer.openHealthHint: /health never requires authentication. Other endpoints follow the access mode below, except Agent chat, cancellation, and page embedding, which always require a token.
apiServer.allowUnauthenticatedHint: Use only for trusted local agents. Any process or browser page on this machine can call the API while this is enabled.
apiServer.allowLanAccess: Allow API and Clip server access from the local network
apiServer.allowLanAccessHint: After restarting the app, the API and Clip server listen on 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1. Use only on trusted networks, and keep token auth enabled unless you fully trust the LAN.
apiServer.mcpEnableHint: MCP uses the local API and the same token rules. Keep the HTTP API enabled, then connect an MCP client to the bundled Node server.
apiServer.mcpUsageHint: Build once with `npm run mcp:build`, then configure your MCP client to run the server below. Use LLM_WIKI_API_TOKEN unless unauthenticated access is enabled.
apiServer.mcpPathUnavailable: MCP server entry was not found. Run `npm run mcp:build` from the LLM Wiki repository, then reopen Settings.
apiServer.tokenHint: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `X-LLM-Wiki-Token: <token>`. Read endpoints may omit it when unauthenticated access is enabled, but Agent chat, cancellation, and page embedding always require it. The environment variable LLM_WIKI_API_TOKEN overrides this field if set.
apiServer.tokenPlaceholder: Paste an existing token or click Generate
apiServer.tokenMissing: No token — Agent chat is unavailable and protected endpoints return 401
apiServer.tokenUnused: Read endpoints are open, but Agent chat still uses this token
apiServer.envTokenActive: LLM_WIKI_API_TOKEN is active and overrides this field
apiServer.tokenWeak: Token is short — consider Generate for 256-bit entropy
apiServer.saveFirst: Save settings to apply API/MCP changes
apiServer.saveFirstExample: Save settings first, then copy an example request.
apiServer.tokenWarning: Keep this token secret. Anyone with the token on this machine can read your project files via localhost.
apiServer.tokenQueryWarning: Prefer the Authorization header — passing ?token=… via URL leaks the value into shell history, logs, and Referer headers.
apiServer.chatHint: POST a message to /chat. The default response is one JSON document. Set stream: true or send Accept: text/event-stream to receive SSE frames while the Agent works.
apiServer.chatJsonHint: Omit stream or set it to false. The request returns after the complete Agent turn.
apiServer.chatSseHint: Frames: meta, incremental agent events, then done, cancelled, or error. done contains the complete aggregate response.
apiServer.chatTokenRequired: Agent chat and its cancellation endpoint always require a token, even when read endpoints allow unauthenticated access.
apiServer.endpointsHint: Replace {id} with a project UUID, a project filesystem path, or the literal 'current'.
apiServer.endpointProjectsNote: List known projects with their IDs and paths.
apiServer.endpointPatchReviewNote: Update one Review item. JSON body: { resolved?, action? } (resolved defaults to true; pass false to reopen). Use the Review tab's Refresh button to re-read.
apiServer.endpointBulkResolveNote: Bulk-resolve Review items. JSON body: { ids, action? }. Returns { resolved, notFound, count }.
apiServer.endpointSearchNote: JSON body: { query, topK?, includeContent?, queryEmbedding? }. Uses shared keyword + vector retrieval when embeddings are configured.
apiServer.endpointRescanNote: Triggers a backend rescan using your Source Watch config.
apiServer.endpointEmbedPageNote: Index one existing wiki/*.md page. JSON body: { path, force? }. Returns its revision and written chunk count. A token is always required.
apiServer.endpointChatNote: Agent chat. Returns JSON by default; use stream: true or Accept: text/event-stream for SSE. A token is always required.
apiServer.endpointChatCancelNote: Cancels the active Agent turn for a session. A token is always required.
